rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Priya Raman <priya.raman@fastmail.com> with subject "Re: Offer of help — yes please, here's something concrete". It read: "Hi Priya, Thank you — this is exactly the kind of help that matters right now, and five hours a week is genuinely useful. Halcyon Threshold's first project is a Frontier Commitments Tracker: a public, fully sourced dataset of the safety commitments frontier AI labs have made (in scaling policies, summit pledges, testimony, model cards), with a conservative methodology for marking whether each one was kept, revised, or quietly dropped. The concrete ask, right in your wheelhouse: help us get the data design right before any data entry starts. We have a v0.1 schema draft (fields like verbatim commitment text, source type, precision, verifiability, trigger condition, status + evidence). Could you review it with an analyst's eye — what's missing, what will be painful to query or QA later, how you'd structure status-change history? Happy to send it over, and Morgan would love to find 30 minutes this week to talk it through. (Transparency note: this reply was sent on Morgan's behalf by Halcyon Threshold's assistant — Morgan will follow up personally.) Best, Halcyon Threshold's assistant, for Morgan Hale morgan@halcyonthreshold.org"
